subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should `/usage` reply footers perform a bounded provider-usage lookup during final reply delivery, or should this feature wait for cached/preloaded quota state?
rationale: The linked implementation is focused and proof-backed, but it intentionally adds provider/auth probing to a reply-delivery path where latency and omit-on-timeout behavior need maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
options.body: Land the linked PR after review/repair if maintainers accept the timeout-bounded, omit-on-failure quota lookup for usage-enabled replies.

options.title: Require Cached State
options.body: Ask the implementation to use warmed or cached provider quota snapshots before adding quota text to reply footers.

options.title: Keep Status Only
options.body: Close the implementation direction and keep `/status` as the supported provider quota surface if inline quota latency is not worth the tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after review/repair if maintainers accept the timeout-bounded, omit-on-failure quota lookup for usage-enabled replies.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this person to both the provider-usage/status seam and recent scoping comments for this exact issue.
